versions.subject: Merge PR #4961 from @tsale - Add multiples rules and updates
versions.detection:
selection:
    Initiated: true
    DestinationPort: 9389
filter_main_dsac:
    Image: 'C:\Windows\system32\dsac.exe'
filter_main_ms_monitoring_agent:
    Image: 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Monitoring Agent\'
filter_main_powershell:
    Image|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe'
        - 'C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7-preview\pwsh.ex'
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\'
        - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\WindowsPowerShell\'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: Initiated=true DestinationPort=9389 NOT (Image="C:\\Windows\\system32\\dsac.exe" OR Image="C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Monitoring Agent\\" OR Image IN ("C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe*", "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7-preview\\pwsh.ex*", "C:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\*", "C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\WindowsPowerShell\\*"))
